summary_zh: 导致客户端或服务端崩溃、把玩家踢出存档、卡死或写坏存档的问题。
summary_en: Issues that crash the client or server, kick the player from a save, hang the game, or corrupt the save.

summary_zh: 服务端与客户端表现不一致的问题：状态、tick、实体同步。
summary_en: Server vs client divergence — state, tick, and entity sync.

summary_zh: 与常见 mod（CarryOn、Cold Sweat、Serene Seasons、ToughAsNails、Legendary Survival Overhaul、Alex 系列等）同时安装时的相互影响。
summary_en: Interactions when installed alongside common mods (CarryOn, Cold Sweat, Serene Seasons, ToughAsNails, Legendary Survival Overhaul, Alex's series, etc.).

summary_zh: 物品与方块的交互、附魔、buff 等功能没有按预期工作。
summary_en: Item/block interactions, enchantments, and buffs not behaving as expected.

summary_zh: 进度（advancement）的触发条件、误触发，以及新存档自动解锁一类的问题。
summary_en: Advancement trigger conditions, mis-fires, and the new-save auto-unlock class of bugs.

summary_zh: 战利品表、精准采集、时运 / 抢夺修饰，以及矿物掉落是否正确。
summary_en: Loot tables, silk-touch, fortune/looting modifiers, and ore-drop correctness.

summary_zh: 合成、酿造、堆肥等配方能否做出、产物是否正确。
summary_en: Crafting, brewing, and composting recipes — whether they work and produce the right output.

summary_zh: 生物的 AI、寻路、攻击 / 驯服 / 繁殖 / 死亡、生成条件、骑乘等行为。
summary_en: Entity AI, pathfinding, attack/tame/breed/die lifecycle, spawn conditions, and mounting.

summary_zh: 实测行为与文档（物品说明、教程书、wiki、mcmod.cn）不一致。
summary_en: Actual behavior not matching the docs (tooltips, guidebook, wiki, mcmod.cn).

summary_zh: 不同视角下的动作差异、屏幕震动、骑乘高度、模型穿模等。
summary_en: Action differences across camera modes, screen shake, mount height, and model clipping.

summary_zh: Iris / Optifine 光影下 mod 的粒子、发光、自定义渲染是否正常。
summary_en: Particle, glow, and custom rendering under Iris / Optifine shaders.

summary_zh: 贴图、颜色、字体、UI 排版与文字可读性。
summary_en: Textures, colors, fonts, UI layout, and text legibility.

summary_zh: 简中 / 繁中（港台）/ 日文下的缺字、误译、术语不一致。
summary_en: Missing strings, mistranslations, and inconsistent terms across zh-cn / zh-hk / zh-tw / ja.
